'''Bantha Steak Soup''' was a type of soup made primarily out of [[Bantha steak/Legends|Bantha steak]].

{{Food-stub}}

==History==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Bren Kingal]] gave a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] a bowl of [[Bantha steak/Legends|Bantha steak]] soup made by his sister.

==Recipe==
Cube 1 thick [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Steak/Legends|steak]]; trim fat, pat dry. Saute meat in [[Bantha butter/Legends|bantha butter]] until brown. Core, seed, and chop 2 large [[ootoowerg]]s, 3 ripe [[drope]]s, 1 small [[Koba (food)|koba]] if available. Add [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] to cooked meat, cook til heated through. Put all in pot of boiling [[Water/Legends|water]]. Cover, simmer at low heat for 3 days. Add [[Roosha topping|roosha]] to taste. Serve 1-2.

==Behind the scenes==
Bantha steak soup appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
